name: Like Life
source:
Like Life's story revolves around [url=/c107002]Kousaka Kazuma[/url] who had to move into his aunt's house due to his parents always being too busy. He lives next door to his childhood friend [url=/c26828]Miyasato Yumi[/url], and the two of them walk together to Shitasouno Academy which they both attend. One day at school, many strange transfer students arrive at school: all over town, objects start turning into girls, though they still retain some form of what they used to be on their person. Kazuma's mobile phone is no exception and turns into a girl he names [url=/c26829]Kousaka Himeko[/url].

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Like_Life#Story]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
《Like Life》的故事围绕着[url=/c107002]高坂和真[/url]展开，他因父母太忙而不得不搬进姨妈家。他住在青梅竹马[url=/c26828]宫里由美[/url]的隔壁，两人一起步行前往他们都就读的下曹野学园。有一天，在学校，许多奇怪的转校生来到了学校：镇上到处都是物体开始变成女孩，尽管她们身上仍然保留着某种形式的东西。和真的手机也不例外，变成了一个女孩，他命名为[url=/c26829]高坂姬子[/url]。

[编辑自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Like_Life#Story]维基百科[/url]]
